svg.text: talk.01 · v0.6 · WARM + DIAL, WITH A BIGGER WHEEL
the owner's choices: palette 1 (WARM), the dial for the modes, labels as stickers or multi-colour print, a bigger wheel
TENTATIVE · NOT A FINAL DESIGN
THE DIAL, CLOSE (about 6x)
OLD AND NEW WHEEL (same scale)
15 mm
19 mm
What changed
· wheel 15 → 19 mm across; the chamfer 12 → 15 mm, so the
rim still sticks out only about 1.2 mm;
· the dial ring now holds 3 mm icons, easier to read and to
make;
· the wordmark is 12 % smaller and the labels moved a little
so nothing touches the bigger pocket.
Labels (the owner: keep it simple)
· stickers, or multi-colour printing (an AMS-style system):
the icons and wordmark become flat colour inlays. Features
of about 1 mm and up should be possible; to be tested on
the printer. Nothing to paint or fill.
· so the plan is: print the dial's icons in colour if the
printer allows, else a sticker on a blank dial.
Still true from before
· palette WARM (orange key, dark wheel); the lid is a snap-
fit with PETG; the dial is read by two switches and a cam.
